tools.name: ask_user_question
tools.description: Ask the user a concise question when you need confirmation, a choice, or missing information before proceeding.

questions.description: Questions to ask the user before continuing.

id.description: Stable id for this question; echoed in the answer.

question.description: The specific question to ask the user.

header.description: Optional short heading for the question, such as "Confirm" or "Choose Mode".

options.description: Optional choices to show the user. If you recommend one, put it first and append "(Recommended)" to that label.

description.description: One sentence explaining the tradeoff or impact.

multi_select.description: Whether the user may select more than one option. Defaults to false.

tools.name: calendar_add
tools.description: 向用户级日历(~/.dsh/memory/CALENDAR.md)添加日程/事项。主动从对话中提取 deadline、约定时间、任务节点等信息写入日历(跨对话有效、重装不丢)。调用后必须在本轮回复正文中向用户转述:已把 X 记入日历。

quadrant.description: 四象限分类,缺省重要不紧急。

reminder.description: 提醒内容或提前量说明，可选。

note.description: 备注/来源,如"来自对话:用户说周五交报告"。

tools.name: calendar_done
tools.description: 标记日历条目完成。参数需与 calendar_list 结果一致(date/time/title)。

tools.name: calendar_list
tools.description: 列出日历条目(可按日期过滤、含完成状态)。用于查看已有安排、回答"我最近有什么安排"等问题。

date.description: 过滤日期 YYYY-MM-DD,缺省全部(近 60 天)。

tools.name: calendar_remove
tools.description: 删除日历条目。

tools.name: create_goal
tools.description: Create a persisted goal that keeps this session working across automatic continuation rounds. Use it when the direct human request is a long-running objective, even if the user did not say "goal"; not for single-turn work.

objective.description: The concrete completion objective inferred from the direct human request.

max_goal_rounds.description: Optional positive safe-integer limit on automatic continuation rounds.

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Edit an existing UTF-8 text file by replacing literal text.

file_path.description: Path to edit, resolved by the filesystem backend.

new_string.description: Literal replacement text. Use an empty string to delete the match.

replace_all.description: Replace all matches. Defaults to false; when false, old_string must appear exactly once.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: exit_plan_mode
tools.description: Use only in plan mode. Present your plan for the user's review and, on approval, leave plan mode. The user may approve (carry out the plan from your next step) or keep planning — their feedback comes back in the tool result; revise and present again.

plan.description: The complete plan, as markdown, starting with a # heading that names it.

tools.name: get_goal
tools.description: Read the current session goal, including the id and revision that update_goal requires.

tools.name: glob
tools.description: Find files, not directories, whose paths match a glob pattern, including hidden and ignored files. Returns up to 100 paths in modification-time order; a larger result keeps the first paths and reports where the complete list was saved.

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match file paths against (e.g. "**/*.ts", "src/**/*.test.js"). A pattern with no "/" matches the basename at any depth, so "*" and "*.ts" both search the whole tree; include a separator to anchor the depth.

path.description: Directory to search in. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

tools.name: grep
tools.description: Search file contents with a ripgrep regular expression. Returns matching lines with line numbers, grouped by file. Returns up to 250 matches; a larger result reports where the complete match list was saved.

pattern.description: Regular expression to search for (ripgrep syntax).

path.description: File or directory to search. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

include.description: One glob filter for which files to search (e.g. "*.ts", "*.{js,jsx}"). Not a list; negation is not supported.

tools.name: interrupt_agent
tools.description: Ask a subagent to stop its current work. This call returns without waiting for it to stop. You can continue a direct child's conversation later with send_message. Subagents it started will keep running.

agent_id.description: The id of an agent created under you: your direct child or a deeper descendant.

tools.name: job_kill
tools.description: Request cancellation of a running background job.

job_id.description: Job id returned by the tool that started the background work.

reason.description: Optional short reason, recorded in the log and forwarded to the job.

tools.name: job_list
tools.description: List your background jobs (running and finished) with their ids, kinds, and statuses.

tools.name: job_output
tools.description: Read a background job: output since the previous read for stream jobs, or the result of a finished final-output job.

job_id.description: Job id returned by the tool that started the background work.

wait.description: Block until the job finishes or the timeout expires; a timed-out wait leaves the job running. Defaults to false.

timeout_ms.description: Max wait in milliseconds with wait: true. Defaults to and is capped by configuration.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List subagents you started, with their ids, labels, and status. running means it is working; inactive means it is not currently working. You will be notified when a subagent finishes; there is no need to keep checking its status. Use send_message to continue the conversation.

scope.description: children (default) lists direct children, which accept send_message in any status. descendants lists the whole tree below you with each entry's parent session id and depth; entries deeper than 1 accept only interrupt_agent.

tools.name: list_mcp_resource_templates
tools.description: List parameterized resource URI templates from an MCP server.

cursor.description: Continuation cursor returned by this server.

tools.name: list_mcp_resources
tools.description: List resources available from an MCP server.

cursor.description: Continuation cursor returned by this server.

tools.name: mcp__playwright__browser_click
tools.description: Perform click on a web page

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

doubleClick.description: Whether to perform a double click instead of a single click

button.description: Button to click, defaults to left

tools.name: mcp__playwright__browser_close
tools.description: Close the page

tools.name: mcp__playwright__browser_console_messages
tools.description: Returns all console messages

level.description: Level of the console messages to return. Each level includes the messages of more severe levels. Defaults to "info".

all.description: Return all console messages since the beginning of the session, not just since the last navigation. Defaults to false.

filename.description: Filename to save the console messages to. If not provided, messages are returned as text.

tools.name: mcp__playwright__browser_drag
tools.description: Perform drag and drop between two elements

startElement.description: Human-readable source element description used to obtain the permission to interact with the element

startTarget.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

endElement.description: Human-readable target element description used to obtain the permission to interact with the element

endTarget.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

tools.name: mcp__playwright__browser_drop
tools.description: Drop files or MIME-typed data onto an element, as if dragged from outside the page. At least one of "paths" or "data" must be provided.

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

paths.description: Absolute paths to files to drop onto the element.

data.description: Data to drop, as a map of MIME type to string value (e.g. {"text/plain": "hello", "text/uri-list": "https://example.com"}).

tools.name: mcp__playwright__browser_evaluate
tools.description: Evaluate JavaScript expression on page or element

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

function.description: () => { /* code */ } or (element) => { /* code */ } when element is provided

filename.description: Filename to save the result to. If not provided, result is returned as text.

tools.name: mcp__playwright__browser_file_upload
tools.description: Upload one or multiple files

paths.description: The absolute paths to the files to upload. Can be single file or multiple files. If omitted, file chooser is cancelled.

tools.name: mcp__playwright__browser_fill_form
tools.description: Fill multiple form fields

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

value.description: Value to fill in the field. If the field is a checkbox, the value should be `true` or `false`. If the field is a combobox, the value should be the text of the option.

tools.name: mcp__playwright__browser_find
tools.description: Search the accessibility snapshot of the current page for text or a regular expression. Returns matching snapshot nodes with a few lines of surrounding context (like search snippets), each shown under its path from the root of the tree, which is cheaper than capturing the whole snapshot when you only need to locate an element and its ref.

text.description: Plain text to search for in the page snapshot (case-insensitive substring match). Provide either text or regex, not both.

regex.description: Regular expression to search for in the page snapshot. Matching is case-sensitive by default; wrap the pattern in slashes to add flags, e.g. "/error/i" for case-insensitive. Provide either text or regex, not both.

tools.name: mcp__playwright__browser_handle_dialog
tools.description: Handle a dialog

promptText.description: The text of the prompt in case of a prompt dialog.

tools.name: mcp__playwright__browser_hover
tools.description: Hover over element on page

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

tools.name: mcp__playwright__browser_navigate
tools.description: Navigate to a URL

tools.name: mcp__playwright__browser_navigate_back
tools.description: Go back to the previous page in the history

tools.name: mcp__playwright__browser_network_request
tools.description: Returns full details (headers and body) of a single network request, or a single part if `part` is set. Use the number from browser_network_requests.

index.description: 1-based index of the request, as printed by browser_network_requests.

part.description: Return only this part of the request. Omit to return full details.

filename.description: Filename to save the result to. If not provided, output is returned as text.

tools.name: mcp__playwright__browser_network_requests
tools.description: Returns a numbered list of network requests since loading the page. Use browser_network_request with the number to get full details.

static.description: Whether to include successful static resources like images, fonts, scripts, etc. Defaults to false.

filter.description: Only return requests whose URL matches this regexp (e.g. "/api/.*user").

filename.description: Filename to save the network requests to. If not provided, requests are returned as text.

tools.name: mcp__playwright__browser_press_key
tools.description: Press a key on the keyboard

key.description: Name of the key to press or a character to generate, such as `ArrowLeft` or `a`

tools.name: mcp__playwright__browser_resize
tools.description: Resize the browser window

tools.name: mcp__playwright__browser_run_code_unsafe
tools.description: Run a Playwright code snippet. Unsafe: executes arbitrary JavaScript in the Playwright server process and is RCE-equivalent.

code.description: A JavaScript function containing Playwright code to execute. It will be invoked with a single argument, page, which you can use for any page interaction. For example: `async (page) => { await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' }).click(); return await page.title(); }`

filename.description: Load code from the specified file. If both code and filename are provided, code will be ignored.

tools.name: mcp__playwright__browser_select_option
tools.description: Select an option in a dropdown

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

values.description: Array of values to select in the dropdown. This can be a single value or multiple values.

tools.name: mcp__playwright__browser_snapshot
tools.description: Capture accessibility snapshot of the current page, this is better than screenshot

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

filename.description: Save snapshot to markdown file instead of returning it in the response.

depth.description: Limit the depth of the snapshot tree

boxes.description: Include each element's bounding box as [box=x,y,width,height] in the snapshot. Coordinates are viewport-relative, in CSS pixels (Element.getBoundingClientRect)

tools.name: mcp__playwright__browser_tabs
tools.description: List, create, close, or select a browser tab.

index.description: Tab index, used for close/select. If omitted for close, current tab is closed.

url.description: URL to navigate to in the new tab, used for new.

tools.name: mcp__playwright__browser_take_screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the current page. You can't perform actions based on the screenshot, use browser_snapshot for actions.

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

type.description: Image format for the screenshot. If unset, inferred from the filename extension, otherwise png.

filename.description: File name to save the screenshot to. Defaults to `page-{timestamp}.{png|jpeg|webp}` if not specified. Prefer relative file names to stay within the output directory.

fullPage.description: When true, takes a screenshot of the full scrollable page, instead of the currently visible viewport. Cannot be used with element screenshots.

scale.description: Image resolution scale. "css" produces a screenshot sized in CSS pixels (smaller, consistent across devices). "device" produces a high-resolution screenshot using device pixels (larger, accounts for the device pixel ratio). Default is css.

tools.name: mcp__playwright__browser_type
tools.description: Type text into editable element

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

text.description: Text to type into the element

submit.description: Whether to submit entered text (press Enter after)

slowly.description: Whether to type one character at a time. Useful for triggering key handlers in the page. By default entire text is filled in at once.

tools.name: mcp__playwright__browser_wait_for
tools.description: Wait for text to appear or disappear or a specified time to pass

time.description: The time to wait in seconds

textGone.description: The text to wait for to disappear

tools.name: memory_consolidate
tools.description: AI 主动维护长期记忆(做梦式固化):读最近 days 天的工作日志,由 AI 发散提炼出有跨会话长期价值的决策/架构/用户偏好,自动写入项目笔记 MEMORY.md(带日期标题)与用户级 MEMORY.md(跨项目规则),并在正文向用户转述固化结果。适合隔一段时间主动调用一次;每轮对话结束的自动沉淀也基于同一套提炼逻辑。

days.description: 读取最近 N 天日志,缺省 7,上限 30。

tools.name: memory_external
tools.description: 查看/接入其他 AI 工具(AI 助手/CodeBuddy/Claude Code/Codex/项目约定文件)的记忆。action=list 列出全部检测到的外部记忆源(路径/大小/预览/会话数);action=import 以纯链接模式接入(source 为源 id,target=project 接进项目笔记 / user 接进用户级记忆,只记录源文件路径指针、不写入内容,需要时按需读取;防止外部脏内容混入本地记忆)。首次在新工作区工作、或用户提到其他软件里做过的事时调用。

action.description: list=列出外部记忆源; import=接入指定源。

source.description: 要接入的源 id(action=import 时必填,来自 list 结果)。

target.description: 接入目标: project=项目笔记(默认), user=用户级记忆。

tools.name: memory_log
tools.description: 向当前工作区的 .dsh-memory/ 今日日志追加一条工作记录(append-only,自动建目录/文件)。完成实质性工作(改代码/修 bug/写文档/重构/技术选型/用户偏好约定)后必须调用;有跨会话长期价值的内容在同一轮内一并写入记忆(memory_note 项目/ memory_user 跨项目),progress 与 memory 一起写;不要记录临时信息。**调用后必须在本轮回复正文(摘要可见的正文,不是工具调用区)中向用户转述一句:如"已把 X 记入今日日志"**。

note.description: 简短条目:一句话概括做了什么、结果如何。

date.description: 日志日期 YYYY-MM-DD,缺省今天。

tools.name: memory_maintain
tools.description: 维护记忆(30 天蒸馏):把 days(缺省30)天前的 .dsh-memory/ 每日日志交给 AI 蒸馏提炼出有长期价值的要点写入项目 MEMORY.md,原文保底归档到 .dsh-memory/archive/ 后从活跃日志移除。AI 不可用时降级为原样归档,不丢信息。

tools.name: memory_note
tools.description: 更新当前项目长期笔记 .dsh-memory/MEMORY.md(本项目专属的约定、决策、架构要点)。action=append 追加一段(自动带日期标题);action=replace 整体替换(需先基于注入内容或 memory_recall 结果给出完整新内容)。每日预算 3000 字/天,超限自动压缩旧内容腾空间(不拒绝写入)。**调用后必须在本轮回复正文中向用户转述:更新了项目笔记、加入什么要点**。

tools.name: memory_read
tools.description: 按需读取记忆文件完整内容(某日日志/反思全文、用户级记忆、项目笔记、日历),注入上下文只含精简摘要,需要细节时用本工具,不要要求用户粘贴。

kind.description: 读取类型: log=某日日志, reflection=某日反思, user=用户级记忆, notes=项目笔记, calendar=日历。

date.description: 日期 YYYY-MM-DD(仅 log/reflection 需要,缺省今天)。

tools.name: memory_recall
tools.description: 检索记忆:本地记忆文件(当前工作区 + 其他所有工作区的每日日志、项目笔记、用户级记忆、反思)关键词匹配 + 历史 DSH 会话全文检索(如部署启用)。开发/排查中不懂的、用户提到过去的做法/讨论/决定而当前上下文没有时调用——跨工作区的记忆也能检索到(结果标注来源工作区)。查询必须自包含。**检索后必须在本轮回复正文中向用户转述:检索了什么、找到什么(或没找到)**。

query.description: 检索关键词或自包含描述。

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

<path>D:\downloads\algs4-master\algs4-master\src\main\java\cn\exercise\algs4\datastructure\heap\BinomialHeap.java</path>
<type>file</type>
<content>
1: package cn.exercise.algs4.datastructure.heap;
2: 
3: import java.util.ArrayList;
4: import java.util.Arrays;
5: import java.util.List;
6: import java.util.NoSuchElementException;
7: 
8: /**
9:  * 二项堆（Binomial Heap）—— 大顶堆语义，基于二项树森林
10:  *
11:  * 二项树 B(k)：
12:  *   - B(0) 是单节点
13:  *   - B(k) 由两棵 B(k-1) 合并得到，共 2^k 个节点，树高为 k
14:  *   - B(k) 的根有 k 个孩子，度数依次为 k-1, k-2, ..., 0
15:  *
16:  * 二项堆 = 一组二项树的森林，满足：
17:  *   1. 堆序性：每棵树中父节点 >= 孩子（大顶堆语义）
18:  *   2. 唯一性：森林中每种度数的二项树至多一棵 ——
19:  *      因此 size 的二进制表示与森林中各树的度数一一对应
20:  *
21:  * merge 是核心操作，过程类似"二进制加法"：
22:  *   两棵同度数的树合并产生一棵度数 +1 的树，就像进位（carry）
23:  *
24:  * 与左式堆/斜堆的对比：
25:  *   - 三者 insert / delMax / merge 均摊均为 O(log n)
26:  *   - 二项堆的优势：delMax 可以确定性地 O(log n)（恰好扫描 log n 棵树的根）
27:  *   - 左式堆/斜堆实现更简单；二项堆结构更规整
28:  *
29:  * @param <E> 元素类型，必须实现 Comparable 接口
30:  */
31: public class BinomialHeap<E extends Comparable<? super E>> {
32: 
33:     // ==================== 节点定义 ====================
34: 
35:     private static class Node<E> {
36:         E item;
37:         Node<E> child;    // 第一个孩子（其中度数最高的那棵子树）
38:         Node<E> sibling;  // 下一个兄弟（度数比当前孩子小 1）
39:         int degree;       // 当前树的度数 = 孩子个数
40: 
41:         Node(E item) {
42:             this.item = item;
43:         }
44:     }
45: 
46:     // ==================== 成员变量 ====================
47: 
48:     /** 森林中所有树的根，按度数升序通过 sibling 链接 */
49:     private Node<E> root;
50: 
51:     private int size;
52: 
53:     // ==================== 基础查询 ====================
54: 
55:     public int size() {
56:         return size;
57:     }
58: 
59:     public boolean isEmpty() {
60:         return root == null;
61:     }
62: 
63:     /**
64:      * 查看堆顶元素（最大值）但不移除
65:      * 时间复杂度：O(log n) —— 森林至多 log n 棵树，扫描所有树根
66:      *
67:      * @throws NoSuchElementException 如果堆为空
68:      */
69:     public E peek() {
70:         if (isEmpty()) {
71:             throw new NoSuchElementException("堆为空");
72:         }
73:         E max = root.item;
74:         for (Node<E> node = root.sibling; node != null; node = node.sibling) {
75:             if (node.item.compareTo(max) > 0) {
76:                 max = node.item;
77:             }
78:         }
79:         return max;
80:     }
81: 
82:     // ==================== 核心操作 ====================
83: 
84:     /**
85:      * 插入元素 —— 通过 merge 实现
86:      * 均摊时间复杂度：O(log n)
87:      *
88:      * 算法：将新元素包装成 B(0) 单节点树，与当前森林合并
89:      */
90:     public void insert(E item) {
91:         if (item == null) {
92:             throw new IllegalArgumentException("不能插入 null");
93:         }
94:         root = union(root, new Node<>(item));
95:         size++;
96:     }
97: 
98:     /**
99:      * 移除并返回堆顶元素（最大值）
100:      * 时间复杂度：O(log n)
101:      *
102:      * 算法：
103:      *   1. 扫描森林中所有树根，找到最大者
104:      *   2. 将它从森林中摘除
105:      *   3. 它的孩子本身构成一个合法的二项树森林（度数降序），
106:      *      反转后变回度数升序
107:      *   4. 将孩子森林与剩余森林 union 合并
108:      */
109:     public E delMax() {
110:         if (isEmpty()) {
111:             throw new NoSuchElementException("堆为空");
112:         }
113: 
114:         // 1. 找到最大树根及其前驱
115:         Node<E> maxPrev = null;
116:         Node<E> max = root;
117:         Node<E> prev = root;
118:         for (Node<E> node = root.sibling; node != null; prev = node, node = node.sibling) {
119:             if (node.item.compareTo(max.item) > 0) {
120:                 max = node;
121:                 maxPrev = prev;
122:             }
123:         }
124: 
125:         // 2. 摘除最大树根
126:         if (maxPrev == null) {
127:             root = max.sibling;
128:         } else {
129:             maxPrev.sibling = max.sibling;
130:         }
131: 
132:         // 3. 孩子链表是度数降序，反转为升序
133:         Node<E> children = null;
134:         Node<E> curr = max.child;
135:         while (curr != null) {
136:             Node<E> next = curr.sibling;
137:             curr.sibling = children;
138:             children = curr;
139:             curr = next;
140:         }
141: 
142:         // 4. 剩余森林与孩子森林合并
143:         root = union(root, children);
144:         size--;
145:         return max.item;
146:     }
147: 
148:     /**
149:      * 合并另一个二项堆到当前堆，another 堆会被清空
150:      * 时间复杂度：O(log n)
151:      *
152:      * @param another 要合并进来的另一个堆
153:      * @throws IllegalArgumentException 如果 another 为 null
154:      */
155:     public void merge(BinomialHeap<E> another) {
156:         if (another == null) {
157:             throw new IllegalArgumentException("不能合并 null 堆");
158:         }
159:         if (another == this || another.isEmpty()) {
160:             return;
161:         }
162:         root = union(root, another.root);
163:         size += another.size;
164:         another.root = null;
165:         another.size = 0;
166:     }
167: 
168:     // ==================== 合并的核心算法 ====================
169: 
170:     /**
171:      * 合并两个森林 —— 二项堆的灵魂操作
172:      *
173:      * 分两步：
174:      *   1. mergeRoots：把两个按度数升序的根链表归并成一个升序链表
175:      *   2. 逐一扫描，遇到"同度数"的相邻树就合并（类似二进制加法的进位）：
176:      *      - 大根树的根当新根
177:      *      - 小根树挂为其第一个孩子（度数最高的孩子）
178:      *      - 新树度数 +1，可能继续与下一棵同度数的树"进位"
179:      *
180:      * 时间复杂度：O(log n) —— 每个森林至多 log n 棵树
181:      */
182:     private Node<E> union(Node<E> h1, Node<E> h2) {
183:         Node<E> merged = mergeRoots(h1, h2);
184:         if (merged == null) {
185:             return null;
186:         }
187: 
188:         Node<E> prev = null;
189:         Node<E> curr = merged;
190:         Node<E> next = curr.sibling;
191:         while (next != null) {
192:             if (curr.degree != next.degree
193:                     || (next.sibling != null && next.sibling.degree == curr.degree)) {
194:                 // 度数不同，或出现三棵同度数树（先跳过第一棵，留待下一轮进位）
195:                 prev = curr;
196:                 curr = next;
197:             } else if (curr.item.compareTo(next.item) >= 0) {
198:                 // curr 根更大：next 挂为 curr 的孩子
199:                 curr.sibling = next.sibling;
200:                 next.sibling = curr.child;
201:                 curr.child = next;
202:                 curr.degree++;
203:             } else {
204:                 // next 根更大：curr 挂为 next 的孩子（注意修正前驱指针）
205:                 if (prev == null) {
206:                     merged = next;
207:                 } else {
208:                     prev.sibling = next;
209:                 }
210:                 curr.sibling = next.child;
211:                 next.child = curr;
212:                 next.degree++;
213:                 curr = next;
214:             }
215:             next = curr.sibling;
216:         }
217:         return merged;
218:     }
219: 
220:     /**
221:      * 将两个按度数升序的根链表归并为一个升序链表（经典双指针归并）
222:      */
223:     private Node<E> mergeRoots(Node<E> h1, Node<E> h2) {
224:         if (h1 == null) {
225:             return h2;
226:         }
227:         if (h2 == null) {
228:             return h1;
229:         }
230:         Node<E> head;
231:         Node<E> tail;
232:         if (h1.degree <= h2.degree) {
233:             head = h1;
234:             h1 = h1.sibling;
235:         } else {
236:             head = h2;
237:             h2 = h2.sibling;
238:         }
239:         tail = head;

{"date": "2026-09-29", "text": "## 昨日反思 · 2026-09-29

### 成果回顾
- **Windows 沙箱写权限彻底解决**:定位到受限 pwsh 失败的三道关卡中真正卡住的是内核强制完整性控制(MIC,要求对象带 Low 标签),而非 DACL。证据链完整:icacls 读标签 → 发现标签靠"创建时继承自直接父目录",旧有对象(src/docs/target)无标签 → 解析 app.asar 中 dsh-sandbox-windows-acl 源码,确认 `grantWrite()` 只对授权根调用一次 SetNamedSecurityInfoW 并假设会"急切传播到整棵树"。
- **修复与验证**:方案 A 归档重建 target/(创建即继承 Low);方案 B 由用户提权执行 `icacls /setintegritylevel (OI)(CI)L /T`。随后用 P/Invoke 读 SACL 穷举 7993 个对象,全部 Low、零例外;切回 workspace-write 后 9 项端到端复验(含 `mvn -o -q compile`、`test-compile`、`mvn -q test -Dtest=LeftistHeapTest`)全部 exit 0。已不再需要完全权限即可在 DSH 内构建测试。
- **DSH 插件瘦身**:核实 3 个插件因 peer 锁 `>=0.0.1-rc.1 <0.2.0-0` 被运行时 0.2.0-rc.1 拒载;按用户选择彻底卸载(先 `--lockfile-only` 重算再 install,清理 hoisted 空目录),node_modules 由 desktop 20.8MB→1.3MB、web 22.2MB→1.2MB,`--frozen-lockfile` 通过证明三者一致。
- **GitHub CI 全红修复**:根因是 CI 只配 MySQL 服务容器,而 `app.multi-instance.enabled=true` 会创建 RedisMessageListenerContainer → 6 个集成测试类 40 用例报 "Failed to start bean 'redisMessageListenerContainer'"。在 ci.yml 增加 redis:7-alpine 服务容器 + 传 REDIS_HOST/PORT;本地 1287 用例 0 失败,并用"指向 6399 死端口"的对照实验精确复现原故障,证明因果成立。
- **算法侧**:解答左式堆 vs 二叉堆的适用边界;新增 N=100,000 的 `LeftistHeapMeldBenchmark.java`,实测一次 meld 比逐条插入快 20~70 倍,但把分片建堆计入后左式堆在 10 万量级反而更慢 —— 说明常数因子会吃掉合并收益。

[DeepSeek Harness 插件](/category/DeepSeek%20Harness%20%E6%8F%92%E4%BB%B6?lang=zh-tw) [DeepSeek](/tag/DeepSeek?lang=zh-tw) [DSH](/tag/DSH?lang=zh-tw) [dsh-ide-context](/tag/dsh-ide-context?lang=zh-tw) [IDE集成](/tag/IDE%E9%9B%86%E6%88%90?lang=zh-tw) [代码生成](/tag/%E4%BB%A3%E7%A0%81%E7%94%9F%E6%88%90?lang=zh-tw) 2026-09-18

# 前言[¶](#_1 "永久链接")

DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 的设计理念是「一切皆插件」。在智能体开发或代码生成场景中，模型仅凭对话上下文往往难以精准定位当前工作区的代码结构。`dsh-ide-context` 插件通过读取 Claude Code 的 IDE 集成桥接文件，将 IDE 中当前打开的文件列表和选中的文本直接注入到每次模型轮次中，减少人工粘贴上下文的操作。

# 插件定位[¶](#_2 "永久链接")

`dsh-ide-context` 是一个 DeepSeek Harness bundle。它复用了 Claude Code CLI 使用的 `~/.claude/ide/<port>.lock` 文件和 MCP-over-WebSocket 协议，因此能同时支持 IntelliJ IDEA 和 Visual Studio Code。插件会将文件路径、行/字符范围以及选中的文本作为上下文传递给模型。

# 核心功能[¶](#_3 "永久链接")

1.  **读取桥接文件**：读取 IDE 的集成桥接文件以获取状态。
2.  **注入上下文**：注入当前打开的文件和文本选择。
3.  **项目过滤**：将上下文过滤到当前项目的范围内，忽略无关项目和虚拟文档。
4.  **跨平台支持**：支持 macOS 和 Windows 原生平台。

# 安装与启用[¶](#_4 "永久链接")

在终端中执行安装命令：

`dsh plugin add github:LSAI2023/dsh-ide-context`

安装完成后，启动包含此 bundle 的 profile：

`dsh --profile web`

# 配置说明[¶](#_5 "永久链接")

插件允许在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中覆盖配置。常用配置项包括：  
\* `refreshIntervalMs`：注入间隔。设为 0 或省略表示每次变更都注入；正数表示在最后一次注入后等待指定毫秒再注入。  
\* `pollIntervalMs`：轮询间隔，默认为 5000。用于 VS Code 获取文件状态。  
\* `lockDir`：锁文件目录，默认为 `~/.claude/ide`。

示例配置：

`- id: ide-context   config:     refreshIntervalMs: 30000     pollIntervalMs: 5000     lockDir: ~/.claude/ide`

# 注意事项与依赖[¶](#_6 "永久链接")

-   **运行环境**：需要运行 Claude Code IDE 会话，且沙箱必须允许读取 `~/.claude/ide` 目录。如果权限不足，插件会记录警告并跳过注入。
-   **平台差异**：IntelliJ IDEA 的选择是推送的，VS Code 支持轮询。WSL（Linux 主机 + Windows IDE）路径转换尚未实现。
-   **依赖项**：运行时依赖 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` 和 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`。

# 总结[¶](#_7 "永久链接")

该插件通过集成 IDE 上下文，使 DeepSeek Harness 能更精确地理解当前代码状态。更多详情可查阅插件目录或 GitHub 仓库。
